findings.problem: The prompt's noun is questions, which is pregunta in Spanish, a feminine noun, so the right answer in this frame is alguna and not the card's alguno.
findings.fix: en: do [any] of you speak English?

back.es: alguno = some, any (in questions); someone, one of them (as a pronoun)

note: If en changes to "do [any] of you speak English?", consider the matching example "¿Alguno de ustedes habla inglés?" / "Do any of you speak English?", which shows the exact form alguno.
